comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
After reaching Rank 4 of Commercial Battle License, you can obtain this by giving away 3000 Merits to get one. According to JP wiki, here's the list of Reward (you get one of these randomly) :

4x Navy Dispatch Request
Asclepius' Medicated Bath
2x Pure Iron Sheet
2x Fine Fur
Ambrosia
Master's Tailoring Tools
Master's Repair Tools
Copper Holy Grail
Holy Water Sprinkler
Damascus Swords
Seeker Coat
Commercial Nickname Issuing Documents (No.2)
Improved Shell Specifications

While some from the lists are confirmed obtainable in Maris, the others could be removed/swapped to something else. But yes still need confirmation and need to be checked later
